messages.text: anyone seen a plugin just silently not load on app startup? no error, it's just... not there
was working fine last week
yeah happened to me, check the plugin log first -- usually shows a version mismatch
oh there it is, yep version mismatch against the app build
update the plugin to match, that should do it
updated it, loads fine now 🙏
@Dave random q but do you know who owns the printer queue for floor 3?
no idea, ask facilities
getting logged out of the web app way sooner than it should, like every 5 min
even while actively using it
is it just the app or does it re-prompt for full login (SSO)?
just the app, SSO stays logged in
ok that's app-level then, not SSO. check the app's idle timeout setting for your role/group -- some roles got a shorter value pushed recently
yep that was it, my role was on the shorter timeout by mistake. got it corrected
lol unrelated but did anyone else's coffee machine break today
😂 not IT's problem but also yes
my laptop screen has this weird blue tint across the whole display, colors look off
started this morning, nothing changed on my end
check display color calibration/profile first, sometimes it gets changed accidentally
checked, profile looks normal actually
ok try an external monitor then, if tint doesn't show up there it's the panel not the settings
tested on external monitor, totally clean. so it's the panel
yeah that's a hardware ticket then, panel defect. I'll log it for repair
thanks!! 🙏
external drive shows up in device manager but doesn't mount, no drive letter or anything
on and off since yesterday
check disk management, does it show as unallocated/not initialized, or does it show a partition but just won't assign a letter?
shows a real partition, just no letter
ok that's a different branch than the unallocated case then, that one's usually just a manual drive letter assignment in disk management -- right click the partition, add a letter
did that, mounted right away. thanks!
quick one -- anyone know the wifi password for the guest network offhand
it's on the printed card at the front desk, not something we hand out in here
getting another one of those exit crashes on the design app, but this looks like the v14.3 thing again
oh yeah the v14.3 bug, vendor still hasn't patched it as of last week
is there an actual fix or just the usual disable-autosave workaround from the SOP
no for v14.3 specifically that doesn't work, autosave isn't the cause this time -- it's actually the new cloud-sync plugin they bundled in that version, it hangs on shutdown
workaround is to disable the cloud-sync plugin specifically (not autosave), Settings > Plugins > Cloud Sync > disable, then it exits clean
tried it, works. good find
yeah this is v14.3-only as far as I've seen, don't think it's worth a full SOP page since the vendor patch should make it moot soon, just flagging here so we remember 🙏
unrelated but is the Friday all-hands still at 3pm
yep, unchanged
